name: timerKit
description: Cancelable, scope-aware World of Warcraft timers with deterministic cleanup of addon-owned scopes.
summary: Cancelable one-shot and repeating timers with ownership scopes, and addon scopes closed at logout through LifecycleKit or EventKit when present.

Pausing.description: Pause and Resume: a running timer paused and resumed later with what was left of its delay, a repeating timer back on its interval after that first fire.
